instruction: Remove all applications except Chrome from your favorites dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Thunderbird and Vim from favorites, keeping only Chrome. Verified using existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric. Expected result contains only Chrome.

Metric logic correct: check_gnome_favorite_apps parses string to list, checks both length and set equality
Parameter handling correct: metric uses rule['expected'] directly (correct pattern for type='rule')
Complete coverage: instruction has 1 requirement (only Chrome remains), evaluator verifies exactly this
Expected value semantically correct: ['google-chrome.desktop'] matches 'only Chrome' requirement
Data flow correct: config sets 3 apps -> user removes 2 -> gsettings reads final state -> metric compares
